name: compare-support-tiers
purpose: The tier-by-tier comparison on the Support page: one column per support tier with its name, who it is for and its action button pinned in the header while the page scrolls, one band per service family with an overline and a title, and one row per service saying what each tier includes — a tick, a dash, or the allowance as text. Each band closes on its own link to the matching pricing documentation, the recommended tier carries an accent bar, and below the large breakpoint the table folds to one tier picked from a select. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'compare-support-tiers', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `select`, `button`, `overline` and `link`.
useWhen: On the Support page, to show what each support tier includes service by service.
avoidWhen: To compare Azion with a competitor → use `comparison-table`.
related: compare-plans` — the same matrix for platform plans, with hints and tags on rows and one closing link.
bestPractices: Give every tier a stable `id`; the narrow-screen picker selects by it.
Mark one tier `highlighted`; it gets the accent bar, the secondary button and opens the picker.
Give every row's `values` one entry per tier, in tier order.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: columnLabel
props.doc: Heading of the service column, shown from the large breakpoint up.

props.name: pickerAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the tier picker shown below the large breakpoint.

props.name: includedLabel
props.doc: Screen-reader text of a ticked cell.

props.name: excludedLabel
props.doc: Screen-reader text of a dashed cell.

props.name: tiers
props.doc: The tier columns, in order; each is `{ id, name, description, highlighted?, action }` with `action` as `{ label, href }`; a tier without a name is dropped.

props.name: sections
props.doc: The service bands, in order; each is `{ eyebrow, title, action?, rows }` where `action` is the closing `{ label, href }` link, and a row is `{ label, values, group? }` with one value per tier: `true` or `✓` ticks, `—` dashes, other text shows as written, empty is blank.
